spot_return: SPX spot_ref simple return from entry to five-session horizon
standard_errors: Newey-West/Bartlett HAC with 4 lags for overlapping returns
mean_attribution: linear: mean return = beta * mean spot return + mean spot-neutral; quadratic: mean return = mean linear spot + mean convexity + mean quadratic spot-neutral
residual_warning: spot-neutral component is not pure volatility; it includes nonlinear spot, volatility, theta, entry spread, and interaction effects
entry_exposure: net forward delta is P&L fraction per unit relative forward move; net cost is positive for executable premium debit and negative for credit
entry_delta_attribution: entry delta spot component = net forward delta * horizon SPX return; the residual contains gamma, volatility, theta, spread, and interactions
fixed_spot_benchmark: dynamic entry-delta P&L = mean entry delta * horizon SPX return + (entry delta - mean entry delta) * horizon SPX return; the second term is the in-sample delta-timing component
full_strategy_spot_benchmark: a second fixed long-SPX benchmark is scaled to the population standard deviation of each complete realized option-return series; funding and spot trading costs are ignored
